texts.400f17c43cfc:
Survival in Amyloidosis

The aims of this study would be to establish cause of death and prognosis in these conditions and the effects of therapy on survival.

We would like to avoid causing distress to relatives by pursuing patients for follow-up after they have died.  The study would allow us to be continually updated regarding deaths of our patients.
